To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the electrostatic immersion objective lens can be used as an effective means of modulating properties of laminar flow electron gun, and the thin modulating electrode can be used to optimize the focusing properties of electron gun.

the electrostatic immersion objective is a better choice than the conventional one in terms of the focusing field and particles' temporal and spacial dispersion,which is mainly attributed to the ununiformity of electric field in the latter.The electrostatic immersion objective has the advantages of high accelerating voltage,high accelerating gradient and high focusing field,which is of great significance in the application to the electron microscope.

the modulating properties of electro static immersion objective laminar-flow gun are studied by the means of analytical calculation,and the modulating means for the performance optimization are proposed.
